title: Horizontal reinforcing.
officialText:
Vertical reinforcement shall be placed enclosed within ¼-inch (6.4 mm) ties, or other
reinforcing of equivalent net cross-sectional area, spaced not to exceed 18 inches (457 mm) o.c. in concrete, or placed in the bed
joints of unit masonry, at a minimum of every 18 inches (457 mm) of vertical height. Two such ties shall be provided at each bend
in the vertical bars.
